column1: # Which Fly apps this estate expects, and in what state.
# verify_estate.sh graded this Mac and nothing else. Production moved to Fly on 2026-08-17
# (prospector-engine, prospector-store-api, prospector-store-web) and Hermes followed on
# 2026-08-18, so by 2026-08-19 the probe's green line covered the machine that had stopped
#   expect         running  = deployed, and every machine started
#                  suspended = deliberately parked; machines are not graded
#   max_deploy_h   red if the last deploy is older than this many hours. 0 = do not grade.
#                  Use it for apps that are redeployed by CI on every merge, where a stale
#                  image means the pipeline stopped, not that the app is down.
#   reason         why this app exists, in one sentence. An app with no reason gets deleted
#                  by the next person reading this file, which is the intended pressure.
# An app on the account but NOT listed here is a fault. That is deliberate: the failure this
# section exists for is a thing running in production that nobody wrote down.
